_comment: Test fixture loaded by tests/run-tests.sh via --settings. --settings MERGES on top of the developer's live ~/.claude/settings.json — it does not replace it. Drift detection in tests/check-structure.sh (Phase 7) FILTERS host-specific claudesk hooks from both sides, then enforces that NO field outside _intentional_diffs_from_live differs, so the merge produces predictable behaviour. To change live settings, edit ~/.claude/settings.json and re-run check-structure.sh; it will tell you if the fixture needs updating.
_intentional_diffs_from_live: hooks.Notification: fixture empties it (live runs the claude-time hook) — tests should not fire the notification hook.
hooks.Stop: fixture empties it (live runs the claude-time hook).

NOTE: claudesk hooks (the developer's wrapper app, com.claudesk.app[.dev]) appear in live on Notification/Stop/UserPromptSubmit but are STRIPPED from both sides by Phase 7 before comparison — they are host-specific and not tracked here. The claude-time hook on UserPromptSubmit (and all other events) IS diffed exactly.
